# tasks_demo's build: the RTOS's package, its system description and its sources.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

set(EmbLinkRTOS_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../cmake" CACHE PATH "The RTOS's cmake/ directory")
set(EMB_SYSTEM "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/system.yaml" CACHE FILEPATH "The application's system description")
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/stack-roots.json")
  set(EMB_STACK_ROOTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/stack-roots.json" CACHE FILEPATH "The stack check's roots")
endif()
find_package(EmbLinkRTOS REQUIRED)

project(tasks_demo LANGUAGES C)

emb_kernel()
emb_add_executable(tasks_demo src/main.c src/door.c src/blink.c src/interrupt_handlers.c)
